name: Zero
source:
Height: 6'1"
Magic: Water

Zero claims to be the guardian of mankind. He follows Rune in order to keep a close watch over him.

He is cold, quiet, and seemingly emotionless. Unlike the others, he doesn't appear to be interested in helping Rune.
